blinding_note: The review input files omit previous labels, prior reasons, queries, Controller, ranks and scores. The conversation contains prior examples, so this is not an independent blinded study.
annotation_unit: territory_doc; links to original queries retained only as provenance
sampling_note: Same 3 groups and same 360 sample IDs; no resampling. G1 purposive pilot, G2/G3 random extension under the original eligible frame. Labels are not a corpus prevalence estimate.
